turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Interesting question! It’s all about context and tone. In those cases, you’re using what we might call "reversed sarcasm" or "reverse speech acts." The key is to ensure the listener understands that despite the seemingly negative phrase, you’re actually praising the person or thing. It’s a bit tricky and works best when both parties know each other well.
